title: SkySim: browser-native, CPU-only multirotor simulator with blade-element aerodynamics and firmware-in-the-loop
description: SkySim is an open-source multirotor drone simulator built around a single dependency-free C++20 physics core (blade-element rotor aerodynamics with momentum inflow, ground effect, vortex ring state, ISA atmosphere, Dryden turbulence and a voltage-coupled LiPo battery). The same core compiles to a Godot 4 GDExtension, a Python shared library with a Gymnasium interface, and WebAssembly for zero-install use in a web browser. Stock ArduPilot and PX4 fly the simulated vehicle through lockstep bridges.
